## References

[V3.4.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x12-V3-Session-management.md#v34-cookie-based-session-management)

> V3.4.4 | Verify that cookie-based session tokens use "__Host-" prefix **(see references)** to provide session cookie confidentiality.

[V13.2.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x21-V13-API.md#v132-restful-web-service-verification-requirements)

> V13.2.3 | Verify that RESTful web services that utilize cookies are protected from Cross-Site Request Forgery via the use of at least one or more of the following: triple or double submit cookie pattern **(see [references](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Cross-Site_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html))**, CSRF nonces, or Origin request header checks.

Only 2 requirements have "see references" as part of requirement text and only one of them is provided in markdown syntax link.

I think requirement description should have clean text without any extra references.

## Links

There are also 77 requirements with links to <https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering>

```
$ grep -r "\[C" . | grep "**" | wc -l
77
```

Those links are also not part of requirement text, maybe we should have another cell in tables for them?

Problem for both - if to use data in JSON format or want to use description text, then you need to cleanup requirement texts manually. Description text is not usable like it should be.
